I’m verifying the exported plan directly against the public problem statement and data, starting by reading the statement, enumerating the available data/artifacts, and identifying whether this is an initial or online stage with any frozen-prefix obligations.

I have the public rule set. Next I’m enumerating the data tables and the current submission so I can reconstruct the constraint system from the exported rows rather than from the producer’s code.

`rg` isn’t installed here, so I’m falling back to `find`. The stage is `initial`, so there is no online frozen-prefix state transition to validate in this artifact.

I’ve confirmed this is the initial stage: only the initial plan and public input tables are relevant. I’m now extracting headers, dimensions, and representative rows to rebuild the admissible domains and balance equations.

I’ve got the schema and domains. I’m moving to a full independent recomputation: every demand balance, DC inventory equation, plant-hour/material/transport cap, and reserve requirement will be rebuilt from the raw CSVs and the exact submitted rows.

The independent recomputation already surfaced a structural issue: the plan appears to use at least one DC-to-customer arc with no public lane record. I’m rerunning the full check with safe accounting so I can extract the full violation set and exact offending keys.
